answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the umber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the raven of the next round.
